notes.title: 1.4.2.0_O r2
notes.content:
I haven't had much free time to work on updates, but I have been hard at work creating a roadmap for getting future updates implemented. In the meantime there are a few minor updates, I won't be making a full version change until more features are ready, but this way you can still get the small changes and bugfixes along the way. I would like to have the Dark Universe boss fight done next month, and hopefully get the next universe added by June. In the background I'm working on a rewrite of the base game to eventually shift over to once it's feature complete, should fix a lot of jank. If you would like to keep up with development please feel free to check out the social media pages below, my personal twitter page is the most often updated, though I have set up a new discord server stealthily to hopefully keep trolls out this time. I will be posting screenshots, spoilers, and random related content there alongside twitter. I would like to thank everyone for being so patient with me over the years, I know my consistency isn't the best, but I'm dedicated to the games I'm publishing.

Changelog

 Added a CRT shader (can be disabled in Main menu Options)


Tweaks

notes.title: The Dark Update
notes.content:
I've been working on a lot of this update in the background, and I'm finally ready to release it! Introducing... The Dark Universe!

Features


 The Dark Universe - A new section of the game to explore with new game mechanics, new species, and twitsted physics.
 Star Events - Stars will now age, and once they get old enough will explode or implode, creating a new area to explore and collect rare items + Ores
 New ProcGen Planets - Higher resolution, terrain heights, plants visible. Scales with planet size.
 Volcanic Biome with new items for hot planets
 New Items for Icy Biome
 Warp Gates will now spawn around Black Holes


Tweaks


 Tutorial Guy has a new outfit every day and has a special halloween costume!
 Textboxes are on the bottom of the screen and new profile Images are used, including randomized ones for Citizens within Cities
 Visual changes for Icy Biome 
 Spawn rates for Influx species adjusted


Bugfixes


 NPCs now have the correct hair style


More to come!

notes.title: 1.1.0.5_O
notes.content:
The second monthly update, the May 2022 Update is out now! Plus we've got a trailer made to show off the new features!

Features


  New Sprites! The entire Solar system, asteroids, stars, and some FTL objects have gotten new textures courtesy of MechanicPluto24! Thank you! 
  Binary Stars! Alpha Centauri Reunited! 
  Landing on Water! An upgrade for your probes that can be purchased.
  Screenshot Mode! Press F3 at any point to hide the GUI for maximum screenshot capabilities! Also F3 to bring it back again.
  Galaxy Sectors! Each Galaxy now has sectors to fit more stars and very generation. More to come with this!
  Quest Mask - The planet you are going to will now have a quest marker on it as well as a tint. This is to assist new players.


Tweaks


 Galaxy Backgrounds have been adjusted to look not as ugly
  New Galaxy Generation! Faster generation + better spread of stars
  The final boss ship can now be seen after it has been destroyed.
  Save files are now sorted by most recent
  Save selection screen now shows time last played
  Esc now back out of save selection & Game mode selection screens
  Doubled number of stars per Galaxy Sectors
  Moon orbits are fixed and they should stay a healthy distance now


Bugfixes


 Main menu was not recognizing that you have a save file
  Comms text boxes fixed so text doesn't go off screen

notes.title: 1.1.0.0_O
notes.content:
Features


 Game Mode Selector! No more hotkeys when selecting what game mode you want to play!
 Multiple Save Games! Now when you continue game, the game will come to a save loading screen where you can choose the save file you want to play! Also has indicators on the most needed info.
 Speed Run Mode! See how fast you can go FTL and submit your fastest times to our Discord and discuss strategy!
 New Prompts for RNG quests!
 300+ Lines of dialogue added to various species. Will be adding more in the future!
 Sunrises & Sunsets! Now every planet with an atmosphere will have some effects during the sunrise and sunsets.
 Probe Storage Indicator! A gray bar will show up next to the probe to show how much of the storage has been used (for rocks), should help new players know how much they can load into the probe per trip! :)
 Trade Centre Elevator! Only 1 floor can currently be accessed, other floors planned for next month’s update.
 Planets are now visible from their moons.


Tweaks


 Landing heights are now shorter and the gameplay loop has a lot less idle time in it.
 Eyelids in Space Station Trading were all the default colour, now matches skin tone.
 Game no longer attempts to stretch when the window size is changed, in order to keep text readable on some displays
 Your ship that you've chosen has a unique name! Check the lore book Human section to see the name of your ship!
 Gas Giants no longer have a black border around the body, looks much better and blends with rings.
 Planets with atmospheres now will have a semi-transparent border around the sprite to show it's all atmosphere-ey.
 Plants are now a little transparent in their leaves, it varies from plant to planet.


Bugfixes


 Memory Leak! Was caused from a change in Monogame 3.6+ that makes Color Objects no longer dispose properly, was able to get around it and ended up improving performance! Also allows for some cool graphics features I didn't have before :)
 Wrecked Ships were crashing the game upon startup for some reason, that's fixed now.
 You can no longer move when the "Leave menu" pulls up from flying away from a star into the V O I D

notes.title: 1.0.5.0_O
notes.content:
Features

Features


 EXPLORATION MODE!

When naming your Universe (The seed for your save) you can hold alt while pressing enter to play in Exploration mode! In this new game mode you will skip all of the tutorial and tutorial quests / story. Perfect for players who just want to fly around and explore.

Shift + Enter to skip menus!

 For more advanced users who just want to skip straight to landing or to the Galaxy Map, you can skip the menus for planets and stars by holding left shift.

Rover Hotkeys!

 Another feature for advanced users! While using your rover you can now press M to mine or C to charge instead of opening the menu and selecting the option. 

Sell All Button!

 We've all been there. Trying to sell ores and getting annoyed trying to just sell all of it at once! Now you can press Delete while selecting ore that you have to sell all of it! This speeds up the grind significantly.

Save Migration Tool!

 You can now go into the Options menu and load a save you have from older versions of Stellaxy! This mostly just applies to Itch.io users, but may apply to some Steam users



Tweaks


 Warnings no longer play while landing in Easy mode as it is being landed automatically anyway.
 New Hint to let player know to use Enter to pull up Rover menu
 Ore menu is left open by default
 You can now unlock the FTL engine by upgrading your ship
 Ship and Story tabs removed, replaced with Scanner and Colonies apps. 
 Removed page 2 of apps, Ship app, story app, exchange app
 Planet indicators in bottom left of GUI now circles instead of squares
 Trade Center and Wrecked Ships doors can now be entered using Enter!
 A menu will pop up when reaching the edge of a solar system allowing you to go to the Galaxy Map, much like how it worked back in Space Game.
 There are now exit signs in the Trade Centre to help the player know that left is exit.
 Science Shop "Sell items" now are blacked out and alert the player they have none to sell.


Bugs


 GUI would freeze after going into a city, causing the player to be unable to open the Ores list
 Debug control left in game for unlocking all aliens, now removed.
 Player is no longer able to buy playing cards twice
 Rover ore scanner no longer shows invalid spikes for resources not possible to obtain on asteroids

 Life indicator darker to help with confusion with quest indicator

notes.title: 1.0.2.19_O
notes.content:
Features


 Crash logs! Now when the game crashes you can post a log. Saved under "%APPDATA%\Roaming\EcrosoGames\SpaceGame\Crash.txt"


Tweaks


 Asteroids now have different terrain
 Dyson Sphere stars now have a dyson sphere in the hyper drive cutscene and in the solar system view


Bugfixes


 Ship skins now work properly
 RNG Quests no longer send players to planets that don't exist when you get the quest in another galaxy
 Hitch Hiker Quests now can be competed if your target planet is a gas giant (you rescue them from orbit)
 Quest arrow now appears every time you get a new quest
 Quest arrow goes away after a quest is completed
 Crash after visiting Jool no longer happens
 Crash when opening factions menu after completing the go to Earth city quest no longer occurs
 Sudden crash when leaving the Trade Centre no longer occurs

notes.content:

Features

 Faction Battles! (Must join a faction by doing quests)
 Gas Clouds (Like supernovas but it has items too)

Bugfixes

 Thrusters sound kept playing after leaving a solar system

 Game not saving story progress for individual species
